title: Health Education B (DPH2108): Main Exam, Fri 27th March, 2026 11.00am
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO IN SECTION B.

items.text: ANSWER QUESTION ONE IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO IN SECTION B.
Define halitosis and state how it can be managed.
State five objectives of health education.
List five principles of effective health education.
Mention five methods of health education.
State five roles of an oral health educator.
List five barriers to effective health education.
Describe the process of counseling in oral health.
State the importance of health education in oral health.
SECTION B: (30 MARKS) - ANSWER ANY TWO
Describe the steps involved in planning a health education session.
Discuss five communication skills required by an oral health educator.
Discuss the role of health education in prevention of oral diseases.
